theme_instructions: Implement a robust light and dark mode toggle. The application must support both, as requested by the user, defaulting to light mode. Do not use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF for backgrounds. Use tinted grays (e.g., #09090B for dark mode).

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' mixed with 'Swiss Brutalism'. Authoritative, highly legible, precise.
rules: No generic Inter for headings.
CRITICAL FOR FINANCE: All numbers, currency, and financial data MUST use 'tabular-nums' (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) to ensure digits align perfectly in columns.
Headings (H1/H2) must have tight tracking (tracking-tight) to feel premium.
Overlines and table headers must be uppercase, text-xs, font-semibold, and widely spaced (tracking-widest).

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro meets Swiss High-Contrast
rules: Use semantic colors for financial data (Green for positive/credit, Red for negative/debit).
In Dark Mode, desaturate semantic colors slightly so they do not bleed or vibrate against dark backgrounds.
Never use full-screen gradients. Keep the UI flat, crisp, and objective.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics).
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or lg:grid-cols-12 for fine-grained control.
rules: Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6). Every pixel matters in a financial cockpit.
Widget Ratios: Summary cards (col-span-1 or col-span-3 in a 12-col grid), Primary charts (col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-8), Feed/Alerts (col-span-1 row-span-2 or col-span-4).
No rounded corners larger than 8px (rounded-md or rounded-lg max). Sharp edges imply precision.
Padding: Cards must have p-6 internal padding. Avoid cramped text near borders.

surfaces.style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) & Flat Solid surfaces.
rules: Card Default: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), NO soft muddy shadows. Use sharp 1px strokes or very crisp shadows (shadow-sm).
Card Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and border color darkens/lightens slightly.
Headers: Use Solid Background with a hard bottom border (border-b). DO NOT use glassmorphism or transparent backgrounds for the main layout, as this is a data-heavy tool and requires maximum clarity.
Radar Alerts: Use subtle tinted backgrounds based on priority (bg-red-50/dark:bg-red-950/20 for critical, etc.) with a solid left border to indicate severity.

components.sidebar: Clean vertical navigation. Top: Brand Logo. Links: Chat, Dashboard, Radar (Alerts), Clientes, Estoque, Financeiro, Configurações. Bottom: User Profile. Use Phosphor Icons.
components.chat_widget: Floating action button in bottom right leading to a slide-over panel OR a dedicated route. UI must distinguish between AI (system) and User messages clearly. Use subtle gray for AI bubbles and primary color for User bubbles.
components.radar_inteligente: A dedicated section or sidebar feed. Cards must explicitly show priority (Red/Yellow/Green) and contain actionable 'Next Step' buttons (e.g., 'Renegotiate', 'Approve').
components.financial_charts: Use Recharts. Line charts for cash flow (zero-baseline). Bar charts for AP/AR. Grayscale grid lines. Apply semantic color only to the data lines to reduce visual noise.
components.data_tables: Use Shadcn Table. Zebra striping or subtle border-b for rows. Right-align all numerical financial columns. Left-align text/names.

rules: Minimalist and snappy.
Hover states on all buttons and table rows (bg-muted/50).
Do NOT use 'transition-all'. Target specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Chart loading must use skeleton loaders (Shadcn Skeleton) instead of spinning wheels to prevent layout shift.
Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast for all text, especially semantic red/green over their respective backgrounds.

CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='chat-toggle-btn', data-testid='radar-alert-card', data-testid='financial-kpi-value').

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Consistent sizing (20px or 24px).

image_urls.description: Professional male headshot for Team Panel / Dashboard Profile
Professional female headshot for Team Panel
Minimal tech logo abstract background for authentication or sidebar header if text logo is not sufficient

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an Executive Cockpit (Sócio Digital) for Brazilian SMEs. The interface must inspire trust, precision, and authority.
Do not use generic 'AI slop' aesthetics like random gradients, floating transparent unreadable UI, or overuse of emoji icons.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts to ensure precision, but use customized Shadcn/UI for logic-heavy components (Dialogs, Tables, Dropdowns).
For Recharts, strip away default stylings. Use Tailwind semantic colors in the chart configurations. Grayscale the grid lines.
The 'Radar' must feel like an operational inbox. Don't just show data; present actionable cards.
Always apply 'tabular-nums' to financial metrics. Align financial values to the right in tables.
Do NOT apply global text-align: center to the App.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (use crisp borders rather than soft shadows).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements (e.g., transition-colors).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on image_urls provided. NEVER use placeholder text for images or avatars.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Create new matching components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
